/-!
# Finite ordered off-diagonal congruence count on the original dyadic interval

The interval is the inclusive natural-number interval from `ceil U` to
`floor (2 * U)`, exactly the original `factorCarrier U`. The modulus is any
positive natural number. Both orders of a pair are counted, and equal labels
are excluded before counting positive differences. This exclusion makes the
quotient interval start at one and removes any additive rounding term.

This leaf proves only a finite arithmetic count. It has no resonance,
Fourier-envelope, root-operator, or spectral estimate among its hypotheses.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.Part3.ResonanceOffDiagonalCount

noncomputable section

open Classical Finset

private theorem increasing_count_le (S : Finset ℕ) (U : ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, U ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * U)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun z => z.1 < z.2 ∧ Nat.ModEq m z.1 z.2)).card ≤
      S.card * Nat.floor (U / (m : ℝ)) := by
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  calc
    _ ≤ (S ×ˢ Icc 1 (Nat.floor (U / (m : ℝ)))).card := by
      apply card_le_card_of_injOn
        (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => (z.1, (z.2 - z.1) / m))
      · intro z hz
        obtain ⟨hzS, hzlt, hzmod⟩ := mem_filter.mp hz
        obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := mem_product.mp hzS
        have hdvd : m ∣ z.2 - z.1 :=
          (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hzlt.le).mp hzmod
        have hdiffpos : 0 < z.2 - z.1 := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hzlt
        have hqpos : 0 < (z.2 - z.1) / m :=
          Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hdiffpos hdvd) hm
        have hqmul : (((z.2 - z.1) / m : ℕ) : ℝ) * m =
            ((z.2 - z.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.div_mul_cancel hdvd
        have hdiffadd : ((z.2 - z.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + z.1 = z.2 := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_add_cancel hzlt.le
        have hdiffbound : ((z.2 - z.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ U := by
          have hlo := (hS z.1 hz1).1
          have hhi := (hS z.2 hz2).2
          linarith
        have hqupper : (((z.2 - z.1) / m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ U / (m : ℝ) := by
          apply (le_div_iff₀ hmR).mpr
          rw [hqmul]
          exact hdiffbound
        exact mem_product.mpr ⟨hz1, mem_Icc.mpr
          ⟨Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hqpos, Nat.le_floor hqupper⟩⟩
      · intro z hz w hw he
        obtain ⟨_, hzlt, hzmod⟩ := mem_filter.mp hz
        obtain ⟨_, hwlt, hwmod⟩ := mem_filter.mp hw
        have hfirst := congrArg (fun v : ℕ × ℕ => v.1) he
        have hquot :=
          congrArg (fun v : ℕ × ℕ => v.2) he
        change z.1 = w.1 at hfirst
        change (z.2 - z.1) / m = (w.2 - w.1) / m at hquot
        have hzdvd : m ∣ z.2 - z.1 :=
          (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hzlt.le).mp hzmod
        have hwdvd : m ∣ w.2 - w.1 :=
          (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hwlt.le).mp hwmod
        have hdiff : z.2 - z.1 = w.2 - w.1 := by
          calc
            _ = ((z.2 - z.1) / m) * m := (Nat.div_mul_cancel hzdvd).symm
            _ = ((w.2 - w.1) / m) * m := by rw [hquot]
            _ = _ := Nat.div_mul_cancel hwdvd
        apply Prod.ext hfirst
        omega
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [card_product, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

private theorem finite_count_le (S : Finset ℕ) (U : ℝ) (hU : 1 ≤ U)
    (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, U ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * U)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun z => z.1 ≠ z.2 ∧ Nat.ModEq m z.1 z.2)).card : ℝ) ≤
      4 * U ^ 2 / (m : ℝ) := by
  let A := (S ×ˢ S).filter (fun z => z.1 < z.2 ∧ Nat.ModEq m z.1 z.2)
  let B := (S ×ˢ S).filter (fun z => z.2 < z.1 ∧ Nat.ModEq m z.1 z.2)
  have hAB : B.card ≤ A.card := by
    apply card_le_card_of_injOn (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => (z.2, z.1))
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨hzS, hzlt, hzmod⟩ := mem_filter.mp hz
      obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := mem_product.mp hzS
      exact mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨mem_product.mpr ⟨hz2, hz1⟩, hzlt, hzmod.symm⟩
    · intro z _ w _ he
      exact Prod.ext (congrArg Prod.snd he) (congrArg Prod.fst he)
  have hsplit :
      (S ×ˢ S).filter (fun z => z.1 ≠ z.2 ∧ Nat.ModEq m z.1 z.2) = A ∪ B := by
    ext z
    simp only [A, B, mem_filter, mem_union]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hz, hne, hmod⟩
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hz, hlt, hmod⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hz, hgt, hmod⟩
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact ⟨h.1, ne_of_lt h.2.1, h.2.2⟩
      · exact ⟨h.1, (ne_of_lt h.2.1).symm, h.2.2⟩
  have hA : A.card ≤ S.card * Nat.floor (U / (m : ℝ)) :=
    increasing_count_le S U hS m hm
  have hcount :
      ((S ×ˢ S).filter (fun z => z.1 ≠ z.2 ∧ Nat.ModEq m z.1 z.2)).card ≤
        2 * S.card * Nat.floor (U / (m : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hsplit]
    calc
      _ ≤ A.card + B.card := card_union_le A B
      _ ≤ S.card * Nat.floor (U / (m : ℝ)) +
          S.card * Nat.floor (U / (m : ℝ)) :=
        Nat.add_le_add hA (hAB.trans hA)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hprefix : S ⊆ Ioc 0 (Nat.floor (2 * U)) := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hS n hn
    have hnOne : 1 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hU.trans hlo
    exact mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨by omega, Nat.le_floor hhi⟩
  have hcard : (S.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * U := by
    have hc := card_le_card hprefix
    simp only [Nat.card_Ioc, Nat.sub_zero] at hc
    exact (show (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.floor (2 * U) : ℝ) by
      exact_mod_cast hc).trans (Nat.floor_le (by linarith))
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hfloor : (Nat.floor (U / (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) ≤ U / (m : ℝ) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (by linarith) hmR.le)
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * (S.card : ℝ) * (Nat.floor (U / (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hcount
    _ ≤ (2 * (2 * U)) * (U / (m : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcard (by norm_num)) hfloor
        (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Inclusive original dyadic carrier; ordered pairs; the diagonal is excluded.
There is no additive `+1`, including when `m > U` and the carrier is empty of
off-diagonal congruent pairs. The endpoint condition `1 ≤ U` is the original
scale condition and includes the case `U = 1`.
-/
theorem dyadic_ordered_offDiagonal_modEq_count_le (U : ℝ) (hU : 1 ≤ U)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (((Icc (Nat.ceil U) (Nat.floor (2 * U)) ×ˢ
        Icc (Nat.ceil U) (Nat.floor (2 * U))).filter
      (fun z => z.1 ≠ z.2 ∧ Nat.ModEq m z.1 z.2)).card : ℝ) ≤
        4 * U ^ 2 / (m : ℝ) := by
  apply finite_count_le (Icc (Nat.ceil U) (Nat.floor (2 * U))) U hU
    (m := m) (hm := hm)
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := mem_Icc.mp hn
  exact ⟨(Nat.le_ceil U).trans (by exact_mod_cast hlo),
    (show (n : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.floor (2 * U) : ℝ) by exact_mod_cast hhi).trans
      (Nat.floor_le (by linarith))⟩

end

end ImbalancedChen.Part3.ResonanceOffDiagonalCount

@[symm]
protected theorem symm : a ≡ b [MOD n] → b ≡ a [MOD n] :=
  Eq.symm

@[trans]
protected theorem trans : a ≡ b [MOD n] → b ≡ c [MOD n] → a ≡ c [MOD n] :=

/-- A variant of `modEq_iff_dvd` with `Nat` divisibility -/
theorem modEq_iff_dvd' (h : a ≤ b) : a ≡ b [MOD n] ↔ n ∣ b - a := by
  rw [modEq_iff_dvd, ← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, Int.ofNat_sub h]

lemma card_le_card_of_injOn (f : α → β) (hf : Set.MapsTo f s t) (f_inj : (s : Set α).InjOn f) :
    #s ≤ #t := by
  classical
  calc
    #s = #(s.image f) := (card_image_of_injOn f_inj).symm
    _ ≤ #t := card_le_card <| image_subset_iff.2 hf
theorem card_union_le (s t : Finset α) : #(s ∪ t) ≤ #s + #t := by grind

theorem mem_product {p : α × β} : p ∈ s ×ˢ t ↔ p.1 ∈ s ∧ p.2 ∈ t :=
  Multiset.mem_product

theorem card_product (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) : card (s ×ˢ t) = card s * card t :=
  Multiset.card_product _ _

@[simp] lemma card_Icc : #(Icc a b) = b + 1 - a := List.length_range' ..
@[simp] lemma card_Ico : #(Ico a b) = b - a := List.length_range' ..
@[simp] lemma card_Ioc : #(Ioc a b) = b - a := List.length_range' ..

theorem le_floor_iff (ha : 0 ≤ a) : n ≤ ⌊a⌋₊ ↔ (n : α) ≤ a :=
  FloorSemiring.gc_floor ha

theorem le_floor (h : (n : α) ≤ a) : n ≤ ⌊a⌋₊ :=
  (le_floor_iff ((FloorSemiring.natCast_nonneg n).trans h)).2 h

theorem floor_le (ha : 0 ≤ a) : (⌊a⌋₊ : R) ≤ a :=
  (le_floor_iff ha).1 le_rfl

theorem le_ceil (a : R) : a ≤ ⌈a⌉₊ :=
  ceil_le.1 le_rfl

lemma le_div_iff₀ (hc : 0 < c) : a ≤ b / c ↔ a * c ≤ b := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, le_mul_inv_iff₀ hc]

lemma lt_or_gt_of_ne (h : a ≠ b) : a < b ∨ b < a :=
  (lt_trichotomy a b).imp_right (fun h' ↦ h'.resolve_left h)

theorem le_of_dvd {m n : Nat} (h : 0 < n) : m ∣ n → m ≤ n
  | ⟨k, e⟩ => by
    revert h
    rw [e]
    match k with
    | 0 => intro hn; simp at hn

protected theorem div_mul_cancel {n m : Nat} (H : n ∣ m) : m / n * n = m := by
  rw [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_div_cancel' H]

theorem div_pos (hba : b ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < a / b := by
  cases b
  · contradiction
  · simp [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, hba]

@[simp] protected theorem sub_add_cancel {n m : Nat} (h : m ≤ n) : n - m + m = n := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_sub_of_le h]

protected theorem sub_pos_of_lt (h : m < n) : 0 < n - m :=
  Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.sub_ne_zero_of_lt h)

theorem congrArg {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {a₁ a₂ : α} (f : α → β) (h : Eq a₁ a₂) : Eq (f a₁) (f a₂) :=
  h ▸ rfl

structure Prod (α : Type u) (β : Type v) where
  /--
  Constructs a pair. This is usually written `(x, y)` instead of `Prod.mk x y`.
  -/
  mk ::
  /-- The first element of a pair. -/
  fst : α
  /-- The second element of a pair. -/
  snd : β

def elabChangeDefaultError (p tgt : Expr) : MetaM MessageData := do
  return m!"\
    'change' tactic failed, pattern{indentExpr p}\n\
    is not definitionally equal to target{indentExpr tgt}"

/--
Elaborates the pattern `p` and ensures that it is defeq to `e`.
Emulates `(show p from ?m : e)`, returning the type of `?m`, but `e` and `p` do not need to be types.
Unlike `(show p from ?m : e)`, this can assign synthetic opaque metavariables appearing in `p`.
-/
def elabChange (e : Expr) (p : Term) (mkDefeqError : Expr → Expr → MetaM MessageData := elabChangeDefaultError) :
    TacticM Expr := do
  let p ← runTermElab do
    let p ← Term.elabTermEnsuringType p (← inferType e)
    unless ← isDefEq p e do
      /-
      Sometimes isDefEq can fail due to postponed elaboration problems.
      We synthesize pending synthetic mvars while allowing typeclass instances to be postponed,
      which might enable solving for them with an additional `isDefEq`.
      -/
      Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVars (postpone := .partial)
      discard <| isDefEq p e
    pure p
  withAssignableSyntheticOpaque do
    unless ← isDefEq p e do
      throwError MessageData.ofLazyM (es := #[p, e]) do
        let (p, tgt) ← addPPExplicitToExposeDiff p e
        mkDefeqError p tgt
    instantiateMVars p

@[builtin_tactic change] def evalChange : Tactic
  | `(tactic| change $newType:term $[$loc:location]?) => do
    withLocation (expandOptLocation (Lean.mkOptionalNode loc))
      (atLocal := fun h => do
        let (hTy', mvars) ← withCollectingNewGoalsFrom (elabChange (← h.getType) newType) (← getMainTag) `change
        liftMetaTactic fun mvarId => do
          return (← mvarId.changeLocalDecl h hTy') :: mvars)
      (atTarget := do
        let (tgt', mvars) ← withCollectingNewGoalsFrom (elabChange (← getMainTarget) newType) (← getMainTag) `change
        liftMetaTactic fun mvarId => do
          return (← mvarId.replaceTargetDefEq tgt') :: mvars)

def _root_.Lean.MVarId.changeLocalDecl (mvarId : MVarId) (fvarId : FVarId) (typeNew : Expr)
    (checkDefEq := true) : MetaM MVarId := do
  mvarId.checkNotAssigned `changeLocalDecl
  let (_, mvarId) ← mvarId.withReverted #[fvarId] fun mvarId fvars => mvarId.withContext do
    let check (typeOld : Expr) : MetaM Unit := do
      if checkDefEq then
        unless ← isDefEq typeNew typeOld do
          throwTacticEx `changeLocalDecl mvarId
            m!"given type{indentExpr typeNew}\nis not definitionally equal to{indentExpr typeOld}"
    let finalize (targetNew : Expr) := do
      return ((), fvars.map .some, ← mvarId.replaceTargetDefEq targetNew)
    match ← mvarId.getType with
    | .forallE n d b bi => do check d; finalize (.forallE n typeNew b bi)
    | .letE n t v b ndep => do check t; finalize (.letE n typeNew v b ndep)
    | _ => throwTacticEx `changeLocalDecl mvarId "unexpected auxiliary target"
  return mvarId
